home.title: A more mindful life begins with inner work.
home.intro: Regeneración Nº 132 is a regular Masonic Lodge: a place for study, fellowship and personal development, open to those who seek to think freely and live with integrity.
home.cta: I would like to learn about Freemasonry
pillars: An intellectual tradition that cultivates reflection, tolerance and the search for truth.
A human bond founded on respect, listening and shared growth.
A daily commitment to shaping one's own rough stone and serving human progress.

regeneracion.label: Regeneración Nº 132
regeneracion.title: A Lodge in Valencia, a way of working in the world.
regeneracion.body: We belong to the Gran Logia de España through the Gran Logia Provincial de Valencia, and we practise the Ancient and Accepted Scottish Rite. Our identity is built on hospitality, discipline, attention to detail and constant personal improvement.

historia.label: Our history
historia.title: A history that deserves to be told with accuracy.
historia.body: The detailed history of Regeneración Nº 132 is awaiting confirmation from its founders. This section is ready to receive the authorised account, without filling any gaps with unverified information.

masoneria.label: What is Freemasonry?
masoneria.title: A philosophical fraternity for free people.
masoneria.body: Freemasonry is a fraternity and institution in the initiatory, philosophical, philanthropic and progressive tradition, founded on freedom of conscience, tolerance and the unceasing search for truth.
items: A centre of fraternal union that respects different backgrounds, opinions and beliefs.
Steady inner work through study, symbolism and mastery of one's own passions.
An active commitment to harmony, peace and the improvement of society.

trabajo.label: Our work
trabajo.title: Improving ourselves also transforms the world around us.
trabajo.body: Study, philosophy, symbolism, fraternity, charity and tradition are the pillars of our work. We collaborate openly and selflessly in social action projects that support those most in need.

biblioteca.label: Reflections / Library
biblioteca.title: Ideas to consider at leisure.
biblioteca.body: This space is intended to bring together philosophical, historical and cultural texts approved for public circulation. Publications will be anonymous and subject to the appropriate approval.

conocernos.label: Would you like to meet us?
conocernos.title: The door opens with a conversation.
conocernos.body: The first step is simple: write to us and tell us what draws you here. We will ask only for the information needed to contact you and, where appropriate, arrange a personal conversation.
items: Be of legal age in Spain.
Be a free person of good character who respects the law.
Have an interest in study, reflection and personal development.

faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.title: Clarity, respect and discretion.
faq.body: Freemasonry is not a religion, a sect, a political party or a business club. It is a lawful and discreet institution that respects freedom of conscience and works through philosophical and symbolic language.
items: No. It is a discreet, legally constituted institution. Discretion protects a space for reflection and trust; reserved matters remain outside the public sphere.
No. It has no dogmas or sacraments and respects its members' freedom of conscience.
May I write to request information?
Yes. You may use the contact form to request general information or express your interest in learning about Freemasonry.
